notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q1564906_hms_investigator.py, tools/sailkit.py, tools/meshkit.py, tools/dresskit.py) with AI assistance. Upright in about 11 m, the hull deep in the silt with only some 3 m of her above it, the upper deck and its fittings intact, the masts sheared off by the ice, the stump of the bowsprit, a few spars half buried around her. The heading (not published: 0), the depth of the silt and the deck fittings are approximate. model_built.glb: the ship under sail in 1850. No marine life in the model: Offlined draws the living things itself.
